newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land closes at 8,800 yen on TSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land closes at 8,800 yen on TSE debut.

text.p: Shares of Oriental Land Co Ltd, which made its debut on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Wednesday, settled at 8,800 yen, compared to the initial offer price of 8,050 yen.
The shares of the operator of Tokyo Disneyland were bid-only for about 30 minutes after the opening and the first trade was done at 8,850 yen.
The share price jumped as high as 9,030 yen in the morning before falling back.
The company said in a statement that costs for developing the second theme park would total 275.2 billion yen.

It also plans to spend about 50 billion yen developing areas surrounding Maihama station near Tokyo Disneyland before 1999. In this project, it plans to build a 500-room hotel, a cinema complex and other recreational facilities.
It plans to use about 140 billion yen raised from listing its shares for the investments.
"For the rest of it, we will procure funds through equity financing and bank loans," said Kagami.
